name: porta-compute
description: Bounded computation in WASM without script I/O

tools.name: compute
tools.description: Run bounded Rhai code without I/O. input_json is parsed into the variable input; the final expression is returned as serialized JSON in the json field. Supports loops, arrays, maps, string processing and decimal arithmetic. Example script: input.a + input.b with input_json {"a":0.1,"b":0.2} returns json 0.3. No Python, JavaScript, imports, file, network, environment or clock access.
